messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Interlingua, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Interlingua line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
que tu me conduce illuc ubi tu ha ora dicate, sic que io vide le porta de Sancte Pietro e illes a qui tu face tanto affligite.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| # | Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Interlingua) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |---|-------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | 1 | che | conjunction introducing the content clause | que | “that” | OK | | 2 | tu | 2nd person singular pronoun, subject of *meni* | tu | “you” | OK | | 3 | mi | 1st person singular pronoun, object of *meni* | me | “me” | OK | | 4 | meni | verb “to lead” (subjunctive) | conduce | “lead” | OK | | 5 | là | adverb of place “there” | illuc | “there” | OK | | 6 | dov' | relative adverb “where” | ubi | “where” | OK | | 7 | or | adverb of time “now” | ora | “now” | OK | | 8 | dicesti | past indicative “said” | dicate | “said” | **WRONG** (lexical form; should be *dixite*) | | 9 | sì | adverb of manner “so” | sic | “so” | OK | |10| ch'io | complementizer “that” (introducing purpose clause) | que | “that” | OK | |11| veggia | subjunctive “may see” | vide | “see” | OK | |12| la | definite article, fem. singular | le | “the” | OK | |13| porta | noun “gate” | porta | “gate” | OK | |14| di | preposition “of” | de | “of” | OK | |15| san | honorific “Saint” | Sancte | “Saint” | OK | |16| Pietro | proper noun “Peter” | Pietro | “Peter” | OK | |17| e | coordinating conjunction “and” | e | “and” | OK | |18| color | demonstrative plural “those” | illes | “those” | OK | |19| cui | relative pronoun “to whom” | a qui | “to whom” | OK | |20| tu | 2nd person singular pronoun, subject of *fai* | tu | “you” | OK | |21| fai | verb “make / cause” | face | “make / cause” | OK | |22| cotanto | degree adverb “so much” | tanto | “so much” | OK | |23| mesti | adjective “afflicted, sad” | affligite | “afflicted” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention
| Category | Item(s) | |----------|---------| | **WRONG** | *dicesti* → **dicate** (incorrect past‑participle; Interlingua form should be **dixite**) | | **UNNECESSARY** | **ha** (auxiliary inserted in “tu **ha** ora dicate”; no counterpart in the source) | | **MISSING** | — none — | | **GRAMMAR** | — none detected (agreement and word order are acceptable) |
All other source tokens are accounted for with appropriate Interlingua equivalents and correct status markings.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Interlingua script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Interlingua text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 133: - Original: **che tu mi meni là dov' or dicesti,** - Issue: **WRONG** (translation of *dicesti*), **UNNECESSARY** (spurious auxiliary *ha*) - Corrected: **que tu me conduce illuc ubi tu ora dixite,**
- Line 134: - Original: **sì ch'io veggia la porta di san Pietro** - Issue: none - Corrected: **sic que io vide le porta de Sancte Pietro**
- Line 135: - Original: **e color cui tu fai cotanto mesti».** - Issue: none - Corrected: **e illes a qui tu face tanto affligite.**
